promptText:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth screen redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, state, and information architecture, not an edit target that must be pixel-preserved.
Primary request: Redesign 02-A-02-login/session-expired as a calm login recovery screen.
Direction: gentle session recovery.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 web app screenshot, no browser chrome and no OS window frame. Preserve the normal login form, but add a clear inline session-expired notice near the top of the form. Include email/password fields, login CTA, recovery link, sign-up link, and social login. Keep the left support/brand visual quiet and secondary.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly Alert/Form/Input/Button structure.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian neutral system. Use Fog or pale neutral alert surface with text/icon; Obsidian #09090b primary CTA only.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: alert should feel calm and non-alarming; no raw provider/session/token details; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS window frame, provider raw errors, token details, scary security language, loud colors, gradients, repeated chromatic actions, oversized bubble cards, watermark.
negativeConstraints: no distorted Korean text as final copy
